summary: iter-166 Wall-Kiosk CMS mess-scoping verified. Backend: 10 new pytest cases (all PASS) cover defaults, unknown-mess fallback, auth gating, super-admin global writes, per-mess isolation (critical invariant), scoped reset, empty-string-inherits-default, partial-update preservation, and empty payload rejection. Regression: iter-160 wave1+wave2 + iter-165 (27 tests) all PASS. Frontend: /admin/kiosk-cms renders correctly, all 3 branding inputs + 4 greeting textareas + Save + Reset present with data-testids. Save round-trip persists to backend AND mirrors greetings into localStorage keys efc.kiosk.greeting_* as required. BUG FOUND: /admin/kiosk page fetches /kiosk/cms (anonymous public route) WITHOUT the current mess_id, so mess-owner customisations never appear in the mess owner's own kiosk header — the header always shows global defaults ('efoodcare'/'ghar se accha khana').

integration_issues.flow: Mess owner customises kiosk headline via /admin/kiosk-cms → opens /admin/kiosk to preview
integration_issues.issue: AdminKiosk.jsx (line ~52) calls `api.get('/kiosk/cms')` with no mess_id query param. The backend public route reads mess_id ONLY from ?mess_id=<X> query (headers/impersonation are ignored on the anonymous endpoint), so the kiosk header renders platform defaults instead of the mess owner's saved override. Verified end-to-end: after successful PUT (backend admin GET returns brand_name='TestMess-UI-iter166' scoped to efoodcare-amravati), /admin/kiosk header shows 'efoodcare' — override never applied.

action_items: Fix AdminKiosk.jsx to load the mess-scoped kiosk CMS. Two options: (a) switch the fetch to `/admin/kiosk/cms` which auto-scopes via effective_mess_id() and returns the merged view (recommended — matches the write path used by AdminKioskCms.jsx and needs no per-request mess plumbing), or (b) resolve the current effective mess_id in context and pass `?mess_id=<X>` to `/kiosk/cms`. Same fix applies to greetings mirrored into localStorage — currently every mess owner's kiosk speaks the platform default because `/kiosk/cms` returns the global doc.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminKiosk.jsx line 52: `api.get('/kiosk/cms')` — no mess_id query; renders global defaults for every mess owner (see integration_issues).
kiosk_cms.py: read-fallback (mess_doc → global_doc → DEFAULTS) and write-scoped (per-mess doc) are correct — mirrors iter-165 pattern cleanly.
kiosk_cms.py `pick()` (line 70): `(mess_doc.get(k) or '') or (global_doc.get(k) or '')` — falsy '0' or 0 would be swallowed, but all fields are non-numeric strings so this is fine in practice.

AdminKioskCms.jsx save handler sends every field (including empties) on save, which will actively clobber prior per-mess overrides with '' — but the backend treats '' as 'inherit', which lets a partial edit still work AS LONG AS the user hasn't cleared other fields on the same session. Consider only sending changed fields to avoid surprise-reset.

rca of the issue: AdminKiosk.jsx was wired to the anonymous public read endpoint that expects an explicit ?mess_id=<X> param. For super-admin impersonation and real mess_owner sessions, the correct scoped read is `/admin/kiosk/cms` which routes through `effective_mess_id(user, as_mess_id)`. Mitigation: change `api.get('/kiosk/cms')` in AdminKiosk.jsx to `api.get('/admin/kiosk/cms')` — no other props/state changes needed since the response shape is the same superset (adds mess_id key which the component doesn't consume).
